data.name: Surge
data.description: As a standard action, you can cause a mighty wave to appear that pushes or pulls a single creature. Make a combat maneuver check against the target, using %1 as your CMB. If successful, you may pull or push the creature as if using the bull rush or drag combat maneuver. You can use this ability %2 times per day.|DomainWaterLVL+WIS|DomainWaterTimes
